training.recovery_selection: latest saved recovery by step only, never validation score
training.sampling: Alternate a counterfactual quartet and four near-goal navigation samples in microbatch 0; microbatch 1 has two navigation samples (80% near-goal) and two retained primitives. Every independent navigation sample chooses new/retained domain with equal probability, balanced blue/red. Approximately 45% near-goal, 25% counterfactual, 5% other navigation, 25% primitives.
training.loss: Original flow matching; shared noise across paired counterfactuals; no oracle features in model batch
training.data: Same 6408 images and 73712 states; captured-state braking labels from dataset04 recipe. Only English prompt variant is sampled.
training.primitive_sampling: Equal probability of original and randomized training-image domains; balanced tasks 2 through 6. Navigation/counterfactual sampling unchanged.
training.frozen_backbone: All vision-language parameters; train action expert and state/action projections only. Verify frozen parameter digest before and after training.

diagnosis: Color interventions pass, but full-mission stability fails under jitter/noise. Teacher horizontal requests during hover/turn are always zero. State-dependent braking is a hypothesis to test, not a proven unique cause.
teacher_change: For armed tasks 2,4,5,6: constant horizontal request -0.8 times captured estimated velocity across each chunk, norm limited to 0.2 m/s. Navigation, landing, yaw, vertical and request labels are unchanged.
frozen: Runtime code, controller gains, detector, success criteria, all original development and held-out layouts/seeds, static-probe conditions and thresholds
evaluation: Final-step weights only. Original development 8/8, exposed round-1 stress >=14/16 with >=7/8 per color and >=3/4 per layout, original rescue regression 5/5, known T3 replay 1/1. No round-2 policy inference or flight until a checkpoint is fixed.
weights_selection: Exactly 6000 optimizer steps from completed train03 final; no intermediate checkpoint selection
user_amendment: English-only model instructions. No Japanese-only performance claim is required.
additional_start_gate: English transition diagnostic of train03 must meet 60/64 directions and 14/16 whole quartets before this frozen-backbone training recipe is used.
runtime_exception: Prompt text only, with byte-diff and AST equivalence after normalizing the seven instruction constants; all other frozen runtime components unchanged.
